reuse.why: Edits only the existing shared getRangeAmount/getExpectedAmount pair, which already uses getApproxNumberThreshold and is called by every schedule consumer.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the change simplifies both branches in their single definitions.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount rule is defined for preview, posting, forecast and templates.

scope.why: Only the two rule functions, their comments, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Two one-line simplifications with updated comments and tests in the one owning module.
